topic: What antenna design trade-offs optimize reception for multi-frequency, multi-constellation GNSS signals with varying modulation schemes?
response: To optimize reception for multi-frequency, multi-constellation GNSS signals with varying modulation schemes, an antenna design should prioritize high-gain patterns in multiple frequency bands and incorporate a wide beamwidth to accommodate various satellite constellations. The use of 3D receiver and transmitter antenna patterns can help mitigate near-far effects and improve signal-to-noise ratio.
